## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests
- [ ] Any design choice is recorded in `docs/decisions/`

For templates and assets:

- [ ] `hyperframes check` passes
- [ ] Licence metadata is in `assets.json`, with proof
- [ ] A preview GIF under 2 MB is attached
- [ ] No GSAP, no network fetches, seeded randomness only
